label: VIIRS active fire detections (S-NPP)
source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m, standard processing (VIIRS_SNPP_SP)
aggregation: count of detections; nominal/high confidence only (low excluded), type 0 = presumed vegetation fire (static sources such as oil-field gas flares excluded), detection point inside county
notes: Single sensor (Suomi-NPP) for the whole 2018-2025 series so trends are consistent. Strongly seasonal (dry season Nov-Mar), zero in most wet-season months. Versus MODIS fire_count (fire_pipeline.py, same months): pooled county-month Pearson r = 0.982, Spearman = 0.969, national monthly r = 0.988, median per-county r = 0.975; VIIRS detects 1.45x as many fires as MODIS (finer 375 m pixels see small fires). Per-county table: data/processed/validation/viirs_vs_modis_fire.csv.

label: VIIRS fire radiative power (S-NPP, sum)
source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m, standard processing (VIIRS_SNPP_SP)
aggregation: sum of per-detection FRP; nominal/high confidence only (low excluded), type 0 = presumed vegetation fire (static sources such as oil-field gas flares excluded), detection point inside county
notes: Sum of instantaneous FRP at overpass time; a proxy for fire intensity x extent.
